judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the initial TDD scaffolding (`.lore/dod.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`) and stopped without implementing any production code. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` are completely untouched, meaning all added tests will immediately fail. Additionally, the tests were placed in `registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the explicitly requested `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) were performed.
